title: Senior Data Scientist– Pricing
jobDescription:
Senior Data Scientist– Pricing Description
- About the role HP's B2B Pricing Data Science team builds the analytics and ML systems that set and negotiate prices for commercial PC and Print products, sold both through channel partners and directly to business customers worldwide. Our pricing engine combines machine learning price and win-rate models, causal price elasticity estimation, and constrained optimization, and is deployed in live A/B pilots across multiple markets. We are expanding the team's global footprint to better support a global product. You will work at the intersection of econometrics and production data science: improving the causal inference core of our pricing algorithm, designing experiments to measure the impact of pricing and process interventions, and shipping your work as production-quality Python code. You will report directly to the team's manager, partner closely with our senior applied data scientist on methodology, and operate with a high degree of autonomy. What you will do Advance the causal inference components of our pricing system: price elasticity estimation (double/debiased ML, heterogeneous treatment effects), uncertainty quantification, and optimization logic. Design, run, and analyze experiments and quasi-experiments (A/B tests, diff-in-diff, synthetic control) to measure the impact of pricing and process interventions, including where clean randomization isn't possible. Translate methodological improvements into production-ready Python code, with tests, documentation, and adherence to team engineering standards. Contribute to the operational health of our production systems: incident support, model monitoring, and periodic retraining and validation cycles. Communicate findings and recommendations to technical and business stakeholders across time zones. What you bring 4–5+ years of professional experience in data science, econometrics, or quantitative research, ideally with exposure to pricing, revenue management, or marketplaces. Strong grounding in causal inference and experimental design: potential outcomes framework, DML/orthogonalization, CATE estimation, instrumental variables, panel methods. Solid applied ML skills (gradient boosting, regularized regression) and the statistical judgment to know when a predictive model answers a causal question — and when it doesn't. Proficient Python for production: clean, testable, maintainable code; comfortable with the scikit-learn ecosystem, Git-based workflows, and code review. Hands-on experience with Databricks (or comparable cloud data platforms) for development and deployment. Proactive, self-directed working style: you reach out early when blocked, over-communicate in a distributed team, and don't wait for co-location to collaborate. Fluent English; comfortable working with predominantly CET-based colleagues. Nice to have Experience with Econ ML, Do Why, or similar causal ML libraries; conformal prediction. Effective use of Gen AI tools for coding and research — our team works extensively with AI coding assistants (e.g., Codex, Git Hub Copilot) as part of daily development. B2B pricing domain knowledge (quotes, deal negotiation, discounting, channel dynamics). Advanced degree (MSc/Ph D) in economics, statistics, or a quantitative field. Education Full time Master's degree, Ph D/Doctorate will be added advantage (not mandatory) #LI-POST Job

title: Financial Analyst-Record to Report
jobDescription:
Financial Analyst-Record to Report Description
- Job Summary This role is responsible for maintaining the integrity, accuracy, and compliance of the company's financial records and reporting in accordance with GAAP and applicable regulatory requirements. It oversees core accounting processes, including general ledger management, journal entries, reconciliations, fixed assets, capital expenditures, revenue recognition, cash flows, and financial close activities, providing timely and reliable financial information to support internal and external stakeholders. Responsibilities • Lead assigned reconciliations, journal entries, close tasks and reporting deliverables end-to-end, ensuring accuracy, completeness, timeliness and strong control adherence. • Review complex account reconciliations, investigate high-risk open items, identify root causes and drive sustainable resolution of reconciling differences. • Prepare, review and approve journal entries with appropriate supporting documentation, accounting rationale and adherence to policies. • Lead month-end, quarter-end and year-end close activities for assigned R2R, P2P, AR processes, proactively tracking risks, dependencies and closure status. • Perform detailed financial analysis, variance review, trend commentary and exception reporting to support business insights and management reporting for balance sheet accounts • Provide accounting support and process oversight for Intercompany, Fixed Assets, Payroll Accounting, Deferred Revenue and Cash Accounting activities. • Oversee P2P payment-related activities by validating exceptions, coordinating issue resolution and ensuring timely and controlled processing. • Oversee invoicing activities, including review, validation, exception management and coordination with relevant teams to resolve billing or posting issues. • Lead AR cash application support by reviewing complex customer receipt matching, clearing open items, resolving unapplied and unknown cash and ensuring accurate customer account updates. • Manage internal and external audit queries by providing complete documentation, explaining process rationale and ensuring timely closure of audit requests. • Strengthen compliance with accounting policies, internal controls, SOX requirements and reporting standards across assigned processes. • Identify control gaps, recurring issues and process inefficiencies; recommend and drive improvements, automation and standardization initiatives. • Support process documentation, knowledge transfer, audit readiness and timely communication of risks, accomplishments and improvement actions. • Partner with cross-functional teams to resolve accounting issues, improve process efficiency, and support operational excellence across the Finance Global Operations tower. • Contributes to automation, standardization, and continuous improvement initiatives within reconciliations, journal entry processes, and financial reporting. • Maintains strong documentation, audit readiness, and timely communication of risks, issues, accomplishments, and process updates. Shift timings-6.30 AM to 3.30 PM and 3.30 PM to 12.30 AM Education & Experience Recommended Professional qualification preferred: Chartered Accountant (CA) or Cost and Management Accountant (CMA India), Certified Public Accountant. • Typically has 4+ years of experience (post qualification) in general ledger accounting, reconciliations, journal entries, month-end close, financial analysis, or related finance operations. • Prior experience in SAP/S4HANA, Cadency and SOX-controlled environments, audit support and process improvement initiatives is preferred. Knowledge & Skills • General Ledger Accounting and Financial Reporting • Account Ownership and Balance Sheet Review • Accounting Standards and Policies • Root Cause Analysis and Sustainable Issue Resolution • Audit Support, Control Documentation and SOX Compliance • Process Improvement, Automation and Standardization Job

Responsibilities • Lead assigned reconciliations, journal entries, close tasks and reporting deliverables end-to-end, ensuring accuracy, completeness, timeliness and strong control adherence. • Review complex account reconciliations, investigate high-risk open items, identify root causes and drive sustainable resolution of reconciling differences. • Prepare, review and approve journal entries with appropriate supporting documentation, accounting rationale and adherence to policies. • Lead month-end, quarter-end and year-end close activities for assigned R2R, P2P, AR processes, proactively tracking risks, dependencies and closure status. • Perform detailed financial analysis, variance review, trend commentary and exception reporting to support business insights and management reporting for balance sheet accounts • Provide accounting support and process oversight for Intercompany, Fixed Assets, Payroll Accounting, Deferred Revenue and Cash Accounting activities. • Oversee P2P payment-related activities by validating exceptions, coordinating issue resolution and ensuring timely and controlled processing. • Oversee invoicing activities, including review, validation, exception management and coordination with relevant teams to resolve billing or posting issues. • Lead AR cash application support by reviewing complex customer receipt matching, clearing open items, resolving unapplied and unknown cash and ensuring accurate customer account updates. • Manage internal and external audit queries by providing complete documentation, explaining process rationale and ensuring timely closure of audit requests. • Strengthen compliance with accounting policies, internal controls, SOX requirements and reporting standards across assigned processes. • Identify control gaps, recurring issues and process inefficiencies; recommend and drive improvements, automation and standardization initiatives. • Support process documentation, knowledge transfer, audit readiness and timely communication of risks, accomplishments and improvement actions. • Partner with cross-functional teams to resolve accounting issues, improve process efficiency, and support operational excellence across the Finance Global Operations tower. • Contributes to automation, standardization, and continuous improvement initiatives within reconciliations, journal entry processes, and financial reporting. • Maintains strong documentation, audit readiness, and timely communication of risks, issues, accomplishments, and process updates. Shift timings-6.30 AM to 3.30 PM and 3.30 PM to 12.30 AM Education & Experience Recommended Professional qualification preferred: Chartered Accountant (CA) or Cost and Management Accountant (CMA India), Certified Public Accountant. • Typically has 4+ years of experience (post qualification) in general ledger accounting, reconciliations, journal entries, month-end close, financial analysis, or related finance operations. • Prior experience in SAP/S4HANA, Cadency and SOX-controlled environments, audit support and process improvement initiatives is preferred. Knowledge & Skills • General Ledger Accounting and Financial Reporting • Account Ownership and Balance Sheet Review • Accounting Standards and Policies • Root Cause Analysis and Sustainable Issue Resolution • Audit Support, Control Documentation and SOX Compliance • Process Improvement, Automation and Standardization Job - Finance Schedule - Full time Shift - No shift premium (India) Travel - Relocation - Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO) - HP, Inc. provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and prospective employees, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, sexual orientation, age, disability, or status as a protected veteran, marital status, familial status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic predisposition or carrier status, uniformed service status, political affiliation or any other characteristic protected by applicable national, federal, state, and local law(s). title: Chief of Staff – AI Organization
locations: Sant Cugat del Valles, Barcelona, Spain
jobDescription:
Chief of Staff – AI Organization Description
- HP is reinventing the future of work through AI, intelligent devices, software, and services. Across Personal Systems, Print, Workforce Solutions, and Digital Services, AI is becoming a foundational capability that transforms how customers create, collaborate, and work. The AI organization is responsible for accelerating HP's AI strategy, delivering differentiated AI-powered experiences. The Opportunity We are seeking an exceptional Chief of Staff to serve as a trusted advisor and strategic partner to the Head of AI. This is a high-impact leadership role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, operates comfortably at executive level, and has the ability to translate vision into execution. The Chief of Staff will orchestrate strategic initiatives across engineering, product, research, finance and executive leadership. This individual will help shape priorities, drive operational excellence, ensure organizational alignment, and maximize the effectiveness of the AI leadership team. . Key Responsibilities Strategic Partnership Serve as a trusted thought partner to the Head of AI on strategy, organizational priorities, and executive decision-making. Translate strategic objectives into measurable execution plans across the AI organization. Identify emerging opportunities, risks, dependencies, and organizational gaps before they become issues. Conduct strategic analyses to support investment decisions, business cases, and executive recommendations. Executive Operations Drive the operating rhythm of the AI organization, including leadership meetings, quarterly business reviews, planning cycles, and executive communications. Develop executive dashboards, KPIs, and performance metrics that provide actionable insights. Ensure alignment across multiple workstreams while maintaining focus on strategic priorities. Cross-Functional Leadership Build trusted relationships across Product, Engineering, Research, Legal, Security, Finance, HR, Corporate Strategy, and Business Units. Lead cross-functional initiatives requiring executive sponsorship and organizational alignment. Remove barriers to execution and facilitate rapid decision-making. Represent the AI organization in executive forums when appropriate. Organizational Effectiveness Improve organizational processes, governance, and decision-making frameworks. Support annual planning, budgeting, headcount planning, and resource allocation. Establish scalable operating mechanisms that enable high-performing teams. Drive continuous improvement across planning and execution disciplines. Executive Communications Prepare executive presentations, board materials, strategic narratives, and communications for senior leadership. Craft compelling messages that simplify complex AI topics for technical and non-technical audiences. Ensure consistency in messaging across the AI organization. Special Initiatives Lead high-priority strategic programs sponsored by executive leadership. Evaluate partnerships, acquisitions, ecosystem opportunities, and emerging technologies. Drive confidential initiatives requiring executive discretion. Qualifications Required Experience 5+ years of experience in strategy consulting, technology leadership, corporate strategy, product management, investment banking, or similar strategic roles. Experience operating within complex global technology organizations. Proven ability to lead enterprise-wide initiatives without direct authority. Experience managing highly confidential strategic initiatives. Preferred Experience Experience in AI, machine learning, data platforms, cloud technologies, or enterprise software. Previous experience as a Chief of Staff, Strategy Director, GM, or Management Consultant (Mc Kinsey, BCG, Bain, or equivalent). Experience supporting C-level or SVP-level executives. MBA or advanced degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. Leadership Competencies Why Join HP AI This role offers a unique opportunity to help shape one of HP's most important strategic transformations. You will work directly with executive leadership to influence AI strategy, accelerate innovation, and drive enterprise-wide impact. The position provides exceptional visibility across the company and the opportunity to help define how AI creates value for millions of customers worldwide. Job

title: Senior Field Technical Support Consultant
location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India / Gurugram, Haryana, India
jobDescription:
Senior Field Technical Support Consultant Description
- The Senior Field Technical Support Consultant is responsible for driving technical escalation management, service quality improvement, partner enablement, operational governance, and customer satisfaction across HP India operations. The role serves as a key technical advisor and escalation leader, collaborating with Field Operations, ATS, Care Center, Supply Chain, Quality, Engineering, and business stakeholders to resolve complex customer issues, improve service delivery performance, and drive continuous operational improvement. Key Responsibilities Service Quality & Operational Excellence Monitor and improve key service metrics including RR30, PPSNC, AIR, AFR, CE Scorecard, and repair quality indicators. Identify operational improvement opportunities through data analysis and trend reviews. Develop and implement corrective action plans to improve overall service performance. Support cost reduction, waste elimination, and serviceability improvement initiatives. Partner Enablement & Capability Development Design and conduct technical, process, and quality training programs for HP partners and subcontractors. Lead Train-the-Trainer (TTT) initiatives, field coaching, audits, and ride-along programs. Develop SOPs, knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, checklists, and customer education materials. Drive partner readiness for new products, diagnostics, and service processes. Customer Experience & Governance Work closely with strategic customers and account teams to resolve business-critical issues. Improve customer experience through proactive communication, technical advisories, and escalation management. Ensure warranty compliance, service policy adherence, and quality governance across the service ecosystem. Represent HP in customer reviews, technical discussions, and operational governance forums. Analytics & Reporting Analyze service, repair, and material consumption data to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities. Build executive dashboards, operational reviews, leadership updates, and business performance reports. Deliver actionable insights to improve efficiency, service quality, and customer outcomes. Support data-driven decision making through report automation and process optimization initiatives. Innovation & Process Improvement Drive initiatives that improve repair efficiency, reduce part consumption, and enhance serviceability. Contribute to automation and RPA projects that eliminate manual effort and improve turnaround time. Lead deployment of new tools, diagnostics, and operational best practices across service teams. Promote a culture of continuous improvement and innovation. Technical Escalation Management Own end-to-end resolution of critical customer escalations and high-impact technical incidents. Act as Subject Matter Expert (SME) for complex hardware and service delivery issues. Drive cross-functional collaboration across Field, Quality, ATS, Supply Chain, Engineering, and Global support teams. Provide technical guidance for root cause analysis (RCA), corrective actions, and recovery strategies. Required Skills Technical Escalation Management Service Delivery & Field Operations RCA & Problem Solving Customer Relationship Management Data Analysis & Reporting Operational Governance Process Improvement Stakeholder Management Technical Training & Mentoring Cross-Functional Leadership Power BI / Excel Analytics Documentation & Knowledge Management Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) RR30 Improvement PPSNC Optimization Customer Satisfaction & Escalation Closure Service Quality Metrics Cost Savings & Waste Reduction Training Effectiveness SLA Compliance Partner Performance Improvement Escalation Resolution Time Operational Efficiency Gains Education and Experience 8-12 years in Personal Systems and Technology Operations. Minimum of Bachelor's degree/ Diploma. Impact Statement This role is accountable for improving HP's service quality, customer experience, operational efficiency, and partner capability across India. The position combines technical leadership, business escalation management, data-driven governance, and cross-functional collaboration to deliver sustainable improvements and customer-first outcomes. #LI-POST Job

title: Director, Service Supply Chain Cost Optimization
locations: Spring, Texas, United States of America
jobDescription:
Director, Service Supply Chain Cost Optimization Description
- The Director, Service Supply Chain Cost Optimization leads financial and operational management activities focused on cost optimization, business performance, and operational efficiency across a complex services and supply chain environment. This role translates financial and operational insights into strategic priorities, executive decision-making, and measurable business outcomes. The Director drives the modernization of cost management practices through advanced analytics, digital capabilities, and predictive decision support, enabling greater operational effectiveness and financial discipline. Key Responsibilities Lead business and financial planning processes, including forecasting, budgeting, performance reviews, and corrective action planning. Drive cost optimization initiatives and operational efficiency programs across the organization. Establish alignment among cross-functional stakeholders to ensure achievement of business, operational, and financial objectives. Develop and execute strategies that improve operational performance and reduce inefficiencies. Implement process improvements that enhance quality, productivity, and cost effectiveness. Modernize cost management practices through digital tools, advanced analytics, forecasting, and predictive insights. Utilize scenario planning, root-cause analysis, and risk assessment to address complex operational and supply chain challenges. Develop mitigation strategies and lead transformational initiatives that improve efficiency, cost performance, and business predictability. Exercise decision-making authority on key operational and administrative matters within the organization. Ensure effective execution of organizational and business objectives. Leadership and Collaboration Lead, develop, and mentor a high-performing team of experienced professionals. Establish strategic priorities and ensure disciplined execution against key objectives. Partner with leaders across finance, operations, procurement, customer support, and other business functions. Influence senior stakeholders and build alignment across multiple organizations and leadership levels. Communicate complex operational and financial topics clearly and effectively to executive audiences. Drive collaboration across regions, functions, and business units to achieve shared goals. Knowledge and Skills Strong business and financial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, cost management, and operational performance analysis. Proven ability to translate financial and operational data into actionable business recommendations. Expertise in analytical problem-solving, scenario planning, risk assessment, and continuous improvement methodologies. Experience leading digital transformation initiatives and modernizing business processes. Systems-thinking mindset with the ability to navigate complex, cross-functional challenges. Exceptional executive communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills. Ability to operate successfully in highly complex, fast-paced, and ambiguous environments. Scope and Impact This position influences strategic direction across multiple business areas, functions, and regions. The role is responsible for driving operational excellence, financial performance, and cost optimization initiatives that support overall business objectives. Decisions made in this role have a significant impact on organizational performance, operational effectiveness, and long-term business outcomes. The pay range for this role is $166,050 to $265,700 USD annually with additional opportunities for pay in the form of bonus and/or equity (applies to United States of America candidates only). Pay varies by work location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. title: Content Operations Project Manager
jobDescription:
Content Operations Project Manager Description
- Job Summary The Content Operations Project Manager supports operational excellence through project coordination, business analysis, process improvement, stakeholder collaboration, and vendor management. This role is responsible for coordinating operational initiatives, supporting business activities, analyzing data, and identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, effectiveness, and overall business performance. The successful candidate will leverage project management, analytical, and communication skills to support stable operations, continuous improvement initiatives, and the achievement of strategic business objectives. Responsibilities Understand HP Print and Services portfolios to support content operations and business initiatives. Support content lifecycle management, operational processes, and continuous improvement activities. Assist in driving process optimization, operational excellence, documentation readiness, and change management initiatives to improve operational efficiency and effectiveness. Analyze operational and business data to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and actionable insights. Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, metrics, presentations, and project documentation to support business decision-making. Apply project management practices, including planning, prioritization, stakeholder communication, and execution in an agile environment. Build and maintain effective working relationships with stakeholders across multiple teams and business functions. Provide coordination, guidance, and support to stakeholders throughout project and operational activities. Coordinate meetings and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to align requirements, manage deliverables, and support successful project execution. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED Bachelor's degree required. Typically 3-5 years of experience in project management, operations, business analysis, or related fields. Experience working in cross-functional and global business environments. Experience with process improvement, operational excellence, business analytics, reporting, or related activities is preferred. KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS REQUIRED Operational excellence and continuous improvement mindset. Project management, planning, organizational, and coordination skills. Analytical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. Ability to analyze data and derive meaningful business insights. Effective communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills. Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities. Working knowledge of process improvement methodologies and operational best practices. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and Power Point, with familiarity with Microsoft Copilot. Experience with reporting, dashboarding, and data visualization tools. Learning agility, adaptability, and willingness to develop new skills and knowledge. Flexibility and willingness to adapt to evolving business priorities, responsibilities, and organizational needs. title: Supply Chain- Operations Transformation Lead
jobDescription:
Supply Chain- Operations Transformation Lead Description
- HP is the world’s leading personal systems and printing company, we create technology that makes life better for everyone, everywhere. Our innovation springs from a team of individuals, each collaborating and contributing their own perspectives, knowledge, and experience to advance the way the world works and lives. We are looking for visionaries, like you, who are ready to make a purposeful impact on the way the world works. At HP, the future is yours to create! We are now Hiring for “Supply Chain
- Business Operations Transformation Lead” role at Chennai location. The primary role will be to own and manage end-to-end Supply Chain operations and transformation across Physical Claims (Sales Returns), Logistics, Procurement, Order Management, Partner Payment Reconciliation and Pricing processes. Ensure seamless operations, perform deep-dive analysis where needed, generate insights on failures, and drive corrective actions. Furthermore, Drive end-to-end supply chain transformation by reengineering processes, challenging the status quo, and implementing innovative, scalable solutions. In parallel, lead partner payment reconciliation activities, analyze spend patterns, and deliver actionable business insights. Additionally, own Pricing and Inventory analysis, along with reporting and analytics for the Services Supply Chain. Manage day-to-day tactical and operational activities to ensure business continuity and performance. Expectations from the

ROLE:
Act as a trusted team member, providing innovative and scalable solutions across SAP and non-SAP environments Manage and optimize Sales Order Returns, Logistics, Procurement, and Order Management supply chain processes Drive and support key Supply Chain transformation initiatives across Product and Services domains by challenging the status quo Collaborate across diverse teams, regions, and supply chain models, operating effectively with minimal direction Exercise independent judgment within defined frameworks to determine appropriate solutions and actions Interpret policies, evaluate complex and unique scenarios, and provide well-reasoned recommendations aligned with organizational goals If you are our Supply Chain
- Process Transformation Lead, you will have a chance to Own a broad portfolio of Sales Order Returns, Logistics, Procurement, and Order Management processes across SAP S/4HANA and non-SAP environments Collaborate with partners and cross-functional internal teams to ensure seamless execution of operations and transformational projects / programs Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) with deep SAP expertise and strong understanding of end-to-end supply chain processes Drive business process re-engineering and transformation, and automate using best-in-class technologies, including SAP S/4 scripting, Power Automate, Power Query, Power BI, Agentic AI, and other digital tools Develop and deliver analytical reports using enterprise tools (e.g., Power BI); identify trends, generate insights, and present impact-driven findings to leadership, including what-if scenario analysis Lead and execute partner payment reconciliations and pricing file processes; perform detailed analyses and provide actionable business insights Monitor and review performance metrics regularly; identify improvement opportunities and drive process, tool, and system transformation initiatives through to implementation Analyse and support priority initiatives within defined frameworks to enable digital advancement, including AI and Agentic AI-driven solutions Provide guidance, training, and mentorship to junior team members to build capability and drive team effectiveness Are you a high-performer? We are looking for an individual with First level university degree (Engineering preferred) Must have minimum 17-20 years of experience in Supply Chain function Experience in more than one supply chain function with primary focus on Sales Order Returns, Logistics (both Forward and Reverse), Procurement, Order Management, Pricing and Partner Payment Recons Minimum 6-8 years of experience in various SAP S4 arenas (Forward Logistics, Reverse Logistics, Procurement and Sales Order management and Material Master) In addition, 6-8 years of experience in driving / owning / leaderng end-to-end Supply Chain Process Reengineering / Transformation projects / programs across countries Must possess strong knowledge of various business flows in SAP pertaining to logistics, procurement and order management and must act as an SME when / where required Deep knowledge of EDIs including creation, simulation and trouble shooting. In-depth experience with B2B platforms used for partner communication with HP systems Excellent communication and presentation skills, with strong attention to detail and executive presence Proven ability to influence stakeholders and build relationships in a matrix organization Strong Microsoft Office skills (expert level in Excel, advance level Power Point) Vocal and proactive in challenging “business as usual operating models” and driving innovative solutions in the product and services supply chain domain Strong Project Management skills to lead cross-functional teams; recognized as Subject Matter Expert. Services Supply Chain experience is an added advantage Disclaimer • This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management. #LI-POST Job

jobDescription:
SPTS Account Manager India Description
- Company: HP’s vision is to create technology that makes life better for everyone, everywhere — every person, every organization, and every community around the globe. With the heart, creativity, and energy of a startup, and the brain, muscles, and determination of a Fortune 100 corporation, we continue to deliver ground-breaking new technologies to build on our 80+ year legacy of innovation. Key Role and Responsibility: Managing existing accounts: (20% of time) Maintain a good engagement with key accounts and keep a close track on accounts’ sales performance, deal opportunities, market feedback, competition, etc. Collaborate with Ops team on customers’ order fulfillment. Provide rolling sales forecast updates every month and POR forecast updates twice a year. Plan and execute programs to drive revenue growth with focus on hp supplies. Promote new products in managed territory. Drive partner/customer loyalty to hp TIJ technology. Keep existing account profile updated in CRM system. Maintain account documents in one-drive, including sales performance, contra-rev program, key meetings notes, and competition. Follow SPTS contract process and ensure relevant agreements/contracts are signed and updated timely. Collaborate with CQE team and AE team to solve product issues and meet customer requests. Provide feedback to ww teams regarding products, pricing, customer requests, competitor moves, etc. Developing new accounts and new projects: (80% of time) Actively Explore, screen and evaluate new biz opportunities through new accounts development and/or new projects with existing accounts. Enter qualified sales leads and prospect info in CRM timely. Maintain sales funnel info updated in CRM and account documents in one-drive. Lead project management in new account development and new project development by following SPTS process. Support local marketing programs both in planning and execution, and drive hp TIJ awareness and preference in managed territory. Provide market feedback and request for ww product roadmap planning. Performance measurement: Revenue achievement of owned accounts. Yo Y growth and seq growth of owned accounts. Partner/customer relationship and loyalty. Sales funnel development and maintenance. Quality of sales funnel, measured by $ growth opportunity. Project management in new account/new projects. Account information and sales funnel maintenance in CRM and one-drive. Product and market knowledge. Internal and external communications. Leadership and teamwork. Compliance to hp guidelines, policies and process. Knowledge and Skills: Knowledge of printing technologies and printing industry including both digital and analog. Strategic thinking and planning. Project management skills Good presentation skill and effective communication Negotiation skill and closing deals Relationship building and maintenance Adaptability and resilience Self motivation in continuous learning and development

- Overview We are looking for a Software Engineer to contribute to HP's Insights Analytics platform focused on Windows endpoint telemetry, diagnostics, and device intelligence. title: Poly Sales Specialist
jobDescription:
Poly Sales Specialist Description
- Job Summary • This role is responsible for identifying customers’ unique requirements and implementing account planning for growth opportunities. The role acts as a subject matter expert, applies consultative selling techniques, and mentors junior account managers. Responsibilities • Demonstrates an advanced level of subject matter expertise and employs consultative-selling techniques to identify and advance opportunities. • Coordinates and owns account plans for strategic commercial accounts, focusing on larger deals, portfolio management, and effectively selling the organization’s offerings. • Identifies complex customer requirements, maps them with the organization’s capabilities, and chooses the most suitable direct/indirect supply chain options. • Builds strong professional relationships with high-level clients, gains a deep understanding of their unique business needs, and aligns the organization's solutions accordingly. • Develops and executes sales strategies, territory account plans, and market penetration strategies to drive significant revenue growth and expand market share. • Analyzes and interprets key performance indicators (KPIs) and market trends to provide strategic insights and recommendations to senior management for optimizing sales performance. • Engages strategically with partners to improve win rates on selective deals and consistently achieves and manages quarterly, half-yearly, and yearly sales quotas. • Leads contract negotiations with major clients, overseeing contract terms and renewals with a proactive approach to ensure profitable deals and lasting positive relationships. • Manages the sales pipeline, enters, and updates opportunities in the pipeline tool, and implements pipeline management practices. • Conducts regular strategic business reviews with key clients, assessing their long-term goals, gathering feedback, and proactively identifying areas for improvement. Education & Experience Recommended • Four-year or Graduate Degree in Sales, Marketing, Business Administration, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence. • Typically has 7-10 years of work experience, preferably in account management, tele sales, product specialty (computers, printers, servers, storage), or a related field. Preferred Certifications • Certified Technology Sales Professional (CTSP) Knowledge & Skills • Business Development • Business To Business • Cash Handling • Cash Register • Cold Calling • Conflict Resolution • Customer Relationship Management • Inside Sales • Marketing • Merchandising • Outside Sales • Product Knowledge • Sales Development • Sales Management • Sales Process • Sales Prospecting • Sales Territory Management • Salesforce • Selling Techniques • Upselling Cross-Org Skills • Effective Communication • Results Orientation • Learning Agility • Digital Fluency • Customer Centricity Impact & Scope • Impacts function and leads and/or provides expertise to functional project teams and may participate in cross-functional initiatives. Complexity • Works on complex problems where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of multiple factors. Disclaimer • This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management. - Print Description
- Business Development Manager – Horizon 3.0 Growth (Print) Location: Gurgaon, India Job Scope: Expert Function: Print Business | Growth & New Business Development Hiring Manager: Dhirendra Khurana About HP HP is a global technology leader and creator of solutions that enable people to bring ideas to life and work better, faster, and smarter. Across our Print business, we are redefining what’s possible—driving innovation, sustainability, and long-term value creation for customers and partners worldwide. As part of HP’s Horizon 3.0 growth agenda, we invest in bold, future-focused opportunities that shape the next generation of the Print ecosystem. Role Summary The Business Development Expert – Horizon 3.0 Growth (Print) will play a critical role in identifying, incubating, and scaling transformational growth opportunities beyond HP’s core Print business. This role is designed for a strategic, externally oriented leader who can operate with high autonomy, navigate ambiguity, and convert emerging trends into scalable businesses. You will work at the intersection of market insight, customer needs, technology, and partnerships to help define HP Print’s future growth engines. Key Responsibilities Horizon 3.0 Opportunity Discovery • Identify long-term growth opportunities and white spaces across the Print value chain, including new use cases, customer segments, technologies, and business models. • Monitor global and regional trends in printing, industrial print, packaging, personalization, sustainability, and adjacent markets. • Develop structured growth theses, opportunity charters, and POVs aligned with HP’s strategic priorities. New Business Incubation & Scaling • Lead end-to-end incubation of new growth initiatives—from concept development to pilot execution and scale-up recommendations. • Build robust business cases, including market sizing, value proposition, financial models, and risk assessment. • Drive rapid experimentation through MVPs, pilots, and proof-of-concepts. Strategic Partnerships & Ecosystem Development • Identify and engage strategic partners including startups, technology providers, OEMs, platforms, and channel partners. • Lead commercial discussions, pilots, and joint go-to-market initiatives. • Build scalable ecosystem models that enhance HP’s competitive advantage. Customer-Centric Innovation • Engage directly with enterprise customers, SMBs, and emerging segments to uncover unmet and future needs. • Co-create innovative print solutions with customers to accelerate adoption. Cross-Functional Leadership • Collaborate with R&D, Product Management, Operations, Supply Chain, Marketing, Finance, and Legal. • Translate market opportunities into execution-ready requirements. Governance & Metrics • Define and track success metrics for Horizon 3 initiatives. • Provide regular updates to senior leadership. • Recommend go / no-go / pivot decisions based on data and insights. Experience & Qualifications • 8–12+ years of experience in business development, strategy, or growth roles. • Experience in Print, Manufacturing, B2B technology, or platform businesses preferred. • Exposure to new business incubation or startup environments. • MBA or equivalent preferred. What Success Looks Like • Strong pipeline of Horizon 3.0 growth opportunities. • Successful pilots with scale potential. • High-impact strategic partnerships. • Clear 3–5 year growth roadmap for HP Print. Why Join HP This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of HP’s Print business by working on bold, transformational ideas backed by HP’s global scale and innovation leadership. Job

title: Technical Support Engineer
jobDescription:
Technical Support Engineer Description
- Job Summary • This role is responsible for independently addressing customer concerns using established protocols, resolving moderately complex technical issues, and providing comprehensive responses about products and services. The role actively collaborates with teams, contributes to customer solution offerings, and aligns their work with global strategies. The role adheres to standards, maintains data confidentiality, and completes process-oriented assignments with minimal supervision. Responsibilities • Operates almost independently, adhering to established protocols to address customer concerns, with a degree of moderate judgment to complement the outlined process. • Resolves moderately complex technical problems encompassing hardware and software through incoming customer interactions and proactive notification systems. • Provides comprehensive responses to questions about services, products, technical matters, and customer relations, including features, specifications, and repairs, for both current and obsolete products, components, and options, in alignment with customer entitlement, such as extended warranty coverage through the enterprise. • Assists customers proactively to mitigate or prevent the occurrence of problems, while also participating in initiatives aimed at enhancing processes or ensuring quality improvements. • Works effectively with clients, programmers, QA testers, and managers to ensure seamless project outcomes. • Provides valuable input to customer solution offerings, aligning recommendations with specific requester needs. • Aligns individual work with strategy, collaborates with teams to enhance operations and implement process improvements to standardize processes globally. • Adheres to established standards, ensuring data confidentiality, and supports execution of business processes with independent judgment. • Completes process-oriented assignments, shares technical information, and supports department-level operational plans. • Identifies and solves varied problems and completes day-to-day tasks with forward planning and minimal supervision. Education & Experience Recommended • High School Diploma/General Education Diploma (GED)/Higher Secondary education or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence. • Typically has 4-6 years of related work experience, preferably in remote support, telephone support, technologies and customer environments, or a related field. Preferred Certifications NA Knowledge & Skills • Active Directory • Agile Methodology • Automation • Computer Hardware • Computer Science • Desktop Support • Help Desk Support • Information Technology Infrastructure Library • Issue Tracking • IT Service Management • Linux • Microsoft Azure • Microsoft Office 365 • Microsoft Windows 10 • Operating Systems • Peripheral Devices • Scripting • Service Now • Technical Support • Windows Servers Cross-Org Skills • Effective Communication • Results Orientation • Learning Agility • Digital Fluency • Customer Centricity Impact & Scope • Impacts multiple teams and acts as a project leader providing direction to team activities and facilitates information validation and team decision making process. Complexity • Works on assignments that are moderately complex in nature and require intermediate problem resolution. Disclaimer • This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management. title: AI Solutions Engineer
jobDescription:
AI Solutions Engineer Description
- Job Summary • This role is responsible for specializing in development and deployment of machine learning models that drive innovation and business value. The role researches and implements appropriate ML algorithms and tools, runs machine learning tests and experiments, and trains and retrains systems when necessary. The role contributes to deploying models in production environments and ensuring their seamless integration. Responsibilities • Develops and programs integrated software solutions, especially in support of the development, deployment and life cycle of machine learning models. • Trains and validates models using appropriate evaluation metrics and techniques. • Optimizes and tunes hyperparameters to improve model performance and generalization. • Deploys machine learning models to production environments, ensuring scalability, reliability, and efficiency. • Monitors and maintains deployed models, making necessary updates to adapt to changing data or requirements. • Spearheads the design of ML systems, experiments with ML algorithms, and regularly trains systems for maximum efficiency. • Designs, develops, tests, and maintains ML pipelines that efficiently produce scalable models. • Cooperates with CI/CD teams to ensure seamless deployment of models to production. • Partners with research and engineering teams to enhance automated model training techniques. • Applies machine learning and statistical modeling techniques to business or research problems. Education & Experience Recommended • Four-year or Graduate Degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence. • Typically has 4-7 years of work experience, preferably in computer programming languages, machine learning, algorithms, statistical methods, or a related field or an advanced degree with 3-5 years of work experience. Preferred Certifications • AWS Certified Machine Learning Specialty Knowledge & Skills • Agile Methodology • Algorithms • Amazon Web Services • Apache Spark • Artificial Intelligence • Automation • Big Data • C++ (Programming Language) • Computer Science • Data Science • Deep Learning • Java (Programming Language) • Machine Learning • Microsoft Azure • Natural Language Processing • Python (Programming Language) • Py Torch (Machine Learning Library) • Scikit-learn (Machine Learning Library) • Software Engineering • Tensor Flow Cross-Org Skills • Effective Communication • Results Orientation • Learning Agility • Digital Fluency • Customer Centricity Impact & Scope • Impacts multiple teams and may act as a team or project leader providing direction to team activities and facilitates information validation and team decision making process. Complexity • Responds to moderately complex issues within established guidelines. Disclaimer • This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management. title: Partner Sales - Distribution
jobDescription:
Partner Sales
- Distribution Description
- Job Summary • This role is responsible for collaborating with partners to transform leads into joint sales activities, tailoring solutions to meet unique customer needs. The role builds strong strategic relationships with partners and promotes the organization's offerings fostering long-term business opportunities. The role mentors junior employees and leads training sessions for partners, continuously monitoring their performance to contribute to the team’s success. Responsibilities • Acts as the expert to the partner for complex information regarding the organization’s products, services, promotions, and configurations. • Develops and maintains account plans to promote sales growth in adherence to legal procedures and requirements. • Partners and transforms potential leads into joint sales activities; creates, fills in, and manages the funnel for deals with partners while achieving and/or exceeding quotas. • Collaborates with partners to tailor solutions that address specific customer needs, including customization of products and services to align with client requirements. • Builds strategic relationships with the partner to ensure long-term business opportunities for the organization. • Promotes and incorporates the organization’s offerings to become a key part of the partner’s business and solutions. • Leads training sessions and workshops for partners, educating them on the latest products, services, and industry trends to enhance their sales capabilities. • Monitors partner performance against targets, analyzing data, and providing insights to drive improvements and optimize outcomes. • Mentors junior team members, sharing expertise, providing guidance, and contributing to their professional development. Education & Experience Recommended • Four-year or Graduate Degree in Sales, Marketing, Business Administration, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence. • Typically has 7-10 years of work experience, preferably in enterprise selling, channel & alliance, or a related field. title: Senior Data Architect – AI Ready Data & Agentic AI Solutions
jobDescription:
Senior Data Architect – AI Ready Data & Agentic AI Solutions Description
- We're looking for a Data Architect who has spent their career deep in data and analytics, and is now hands-on with the latest AI technology stacks — someone who can architect AI-ready data for agentic workflows, not just talk about it. This is an individual contributor role on the technical career path, but at this level, that means leading from the front: owning technical direction across workstreams, driving deliverables with cross-functional teams, and bringing clarity to ambiguous, high-stakes architectural problems. You'll interact regularly with technical teams, business partners, and executives across HP's business units, working on the next phase of agentic AI for the enterprise alongside our frontier technology partners. This isn't an advisory or Power Point role — you'll be building, not just designing. What You'll Do Architect AI-ready data foundations, including the semantic and context layers that make enterprise data usable by LLMs and agentic workflows. Lead technical workstreams end-to-end — setting direction, aligning teams, and owning clearly defined deliverables. Partner directly with frontier AI vendors and internal stakeholders to prototype, validate, and scale new architectural patterns. Shape enterprise data strategy and platform architecture, spanning data warehousing, modeling, and governance. Build hands-on solutions using LLMs — not just evaluate or recommend them. Engage confidently with business and executive stakeholders across HP's business units, translating complex architecture into business context and vice versa. What You'll Bring 10+ years designing and delivering enterprise data warehousing solutions, with deep expertise in data modeling, data engineering and enterprise data architecture — Data & Analytics should be the throughline of your career, not a chapter in it. Four-year or Graduate Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence. Proven track record defining data strategy and platform architecture within a large, complex enterprise. Broad enterprise knowledge spanning multiple business domains (Supply Chain, Finance, Sales, Customer, etc.) and data subjects — you understand data beyond the technical layer and can connect architecture to business outcomes. 3+ years of hands-on experience with modern AI architecture, including building real, production-grade solutions using LLMs and applied AI solution design — pilots and proof-of-concepts alone don't meet this bar. Hands-on experience with Databricks and Microsoft Fabric is strongly preferred; familiarity with the broader Azure and AWS data ecosystem is expected. Comfort working across multiple technologies and platforms, with a clear, demonstrable habit of continuously learning as the landscape shifts. Strong communication and influencing skills — equally effective shaping strategy with senior leadership and rolling up your sleeves on the architecture itself. About the Team The Enterprise Data & Analytics (EDA) organization is HP's central team for corporate data — covering Data Architecture, Data Strategy, Data Engineering, Data Platforms and Analytics for initiatives that span the entire company. As a Principal Architect on this team, you'll work directly with technical and business teams across HP's business units, and have a real seat at the table in shaping HP's data and AI strategy. Why This Role You'll be working on problems that don't have established playbooks yet, alongside some of the top technology companies in the world who HP has partnered with at the frontier of AI. If you've spent your career in data and you're ready to apply that depth to where enterprise AI is actually heading, this is the role. Job

description: Senior Data Architect – AI Ready Data & Agentic AI Solutions Description - We're looking for a Data Architect who has spent their career deep in data and analytics, and is now hands-on with the latest AI technology stacks — someone who can architect AI-ready data for agentic workflows, not just talk about it. This is an individual contributor role on the technical career path, but at this level, that means leading from the front: owning technical direction across workstreams, driving deliverables with cross-functional teams, and bringing clarity to ambiguous, high-stakes architectural problems. You'll interact regularly with technical teams, business partners, and executives across HP's business units, working on the next phase of agentic AI for the enterprise alongside our frontier technology partners. This isn't an advisory or PowerPoint role — you'll be building, not just designing. What You'll Do Architect AI-ready data foundations, including the semantic and context layers that make enterprise data usable by LLMs and agentic workflows. Lead technical workstreams end-to-end — setting direction, aligning teams, and owning clearly defined deliverables. Partner directly with frontier AI vendors and internal stakeholders to prototype, validate, and scale new architectural patterns. Shape enterprise data strategy and platform architecture, spanning data warehousing, modeling, and governance. Build hands-on solutions using LLMs — not just evaluate or recommend them. Engage confidently with business and executive stakeholders across HP's business units, translating complex architecture into business context and vice versa. What You'll Bring 10+ years designing and delivering enterprise data warehousing solutions, with deep expertise in data modeling, data engineering and enterprise data architecture — Data & Analytics should be the throughline of your career, not a chapter in it. Four-year or Graduate Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence. Proven track record defining data strategy and platform architecture within a large, complex enterprise. Broad enterprise knowledge spanning multiple business domains (Supply Chain, Finance, Sales, Customer, etc.) and data subjects — you understand data beyond the technical layer and can connect architecture to business outcomes. 3+ years of hands-on experience with modern AI architecture, including building real, production-grade solutions using LLMs and applied AI solution design — pilots and proof-of-concepts alone don't meet this bar. Hands-on experience with Databricks and Microsoft Fabric is strongly preferred; familiarity with the broader Azure and AWS data ecosystem is expected. Comfort working across multiple technologies and platforms, with a clear, demonstrable habit of continuously learning as the landscape shifts. Strong communication and influencing skills — equally effective shaping strategy with senior leadership and rolling up your sleeves on the architecture itself. About the Team The Enterprise Data & Analytics (EDA) organization is HP's central team for corporate data — covering Data Architecture, Data Strategy, Data Engineering, Data Platforms and Analytics for initiatives that span the entire company. As a Principal Architect on this team, you'll work directly with technical and business teams across HP's business units, and have a real seat at the table in shaping HP's data and AI strategy. Why This Role You'll be working on problems that don't have established playbooks yet, alongside some of the top technology companies in the world who HP has partnered with at the frontier of AI. If you've spent your career in data and you're ready to apply that depth to where enterprise AI is actually heading, this is the role. title: Windows Virtualization Operations Engineer
jobDescription:
Windows Virtualization Operations Engineer Description
- Senior Windows Virtualization and Infrastructure Operations Engineer Job Summary We are seeking an expert-level Senior Windows, Virtualization and Infrastructure Operations Engineer to manage, optimize, secure, and continuously improve enterprise infrastructure platforms. The role will provide deep technical ownership across Windows Server, VMware, Microsoft Hyper-V, HPE server and blade environments, HPE One View, HPE Simpli Vity, Windows clustering, patch management, vulnerability remediation, firmware updates, storage, backup, monitoring, and infrastructure automation. The successful candidate will lead complex technical troubleshooting, major incident response, Change and Problem Management, Root Cause Analysis, capacity planning, proactive maintenance, and continuous improvement initiatives. The role will work closely with Engineering teams and end users to deliver reliable and effective infrastructure services, while also overseeing Managed Service Providers to ensure consistent service quality, strong operational governance, effective automation, and compliance with technical and security standards. Responsibilities Windows and Virtualization Administrate and support enterprise Windows Server environments across physical and virtual platforms, Manage VMware v Sphere environments, including ESXi, v Center, clusters, HA, DRS, v Motion, templates, snapshots, and virtual networking. Support Microsoft Hyper-V platforms, including Failover Clustering, Live Migration, CSV, virtual switches, and VM lifecycle management. Troubleshoot complex operating system, virtualization, networking, storage, performance, application dependency, and availability issues. Lead patching and vulnerability remediation for Windows servers, virtualization hosts, firmware, and infrastructure components in coordination with security teams and MSPs. Support HPE One View, Simpli Vity, Pro Liant DL/BL servers, and Blade System c7000 environments, including hardware replacements, upgrades, vendor escalations, and lifecycle activities. Plan and execute firmware upgrades using validated compatibility matrices, implementation plans, maintenance windows, and rollback procedures. Provide technical leadership during major incidents, high-severity outages, service restoration, recovery activities, and on-call support. Drive Problem Management, root-cause analysis, permanent corrective actions, technical escalation, stakeholder communication, and accurate documentation. Develop automation and strengthen AIOps monitoring across Windows, VMware, Hyper-V, HPE, storage, backup, and clustering platforms. Monitor infrastructure utilization, performance, availability, capacity, growth trends, licensing, SAN/NAS, RAID, LUNs, datastores, multipathing, IOPS, latency, backup, restore, and disaster recovery. Review and govern MSP performance across incidents, changes, problems, patching, vulnerability remediation, monitoring, automation, service improvement, and accountability for outcomes. Support knowledge of DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, domain controllers, replication, authentication, certificates, and access controls. Education & Experience Recommended • Four-year or Graduate Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence. • Typically has 12-15 years of work experience, preferably in computer programming languages, testing tools, or a related field. Preferred Certifications Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator & Azure Administrator Associate or relevant Microsoft infrastructure certification. VMware Certified Professional — Data Center Virtualization (VCP-DCV). HPE certifications covering Pro Liant servers, HPE One View, Blade System, or HPE Simpli Vity. ITIL Foundation certification AWX automation-related certification. Knowledge & Skills Technical Knowledge Expert knowledge of Windows Server administration, troubleshooting, hardening, performance analysis, and lifecycle management. Strong knowledge of Microsoft Hyper-V, Failover Clustering, CSV, Live Migration, and virtual machine management. Strong knowledge of Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, Kerberos, LDAP, replication, certificates, and identity security. Advanced knowledge of VMware v Sphere, ESXi, v Center, HA, DRS, v Motion, clusters, snapshots, and virtual networking. Hands-on knowledge of HPE Pro Liant DL/BL servers, c7000, HPE One View, and HPE Simpli Vity. Strong understanding of patch management, vulnerability remediation, firmware lifecycle management, and configuration compliance. Practical understanding of storage, SAN/NAS, RAID, datastores, multipathing, backup, restore, replication, and disaster recovery. Strong knowledge of monitoring, observability, event correlation, alert management, capacity management, and service health. Advanced Power Shell scripting skills, including automation, reporting, error handling, logging, testing, and remediation. Working knowledge of ITIL-based Incident, Major Incident, Change, Problem, and Configuration Management processes. Public Cloud Knowledge AWS, Azure Professional and Operational Skills Expert-level analytical thinking and deep technical troubleshooting ability. Ability to lead complex incidents calmly and make sound decisions under pressure. Strong Root Cause Analysis, problem-solving, risk assessment, and permanent remediation skills. Excellent communication skills with technical teams, business stakeholders, vendors, and Managed Service Providers. Strong documentation, planning, reporting, and governance capabilities. Ability to translate complex technical issues into clear business impact and recommended actions. Strong ownership, accountability, collaboration, and service-management mindset. Ability to identify opportunities for automation, standardization, proactive maintenance, and operational improvement. Ability to manage competing priorities in a highly available, enterprise production environment. Cross-Org Skills • Effective Communication • Results Orientation • Learning Agility • Digital Fluency • Customer Centricity Impact & Scope • Impacts function and leads and/or provides expertise to functional project teams and may participate in cross-functional initiatives. Complexity • Works on complex problems where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of multiple factors. Disclaimer • This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management. title: Principal Financial Analyst
jobDescription:
Job Summary • This role is responsible for leading and advising on critical business initiatives, overseeing analysts across finance sub-functions and geographies/organizations. title: Digital Support Operations Specialist
jobDescription:
Job Summary The Digital Operations Specialist is responsible for supporting HP's Software & Driver delivery operations and customer-facing support platforms (support.hp.com, HP Support Assistant, HP.com, etc). The role ensures operational excellence across software publishing processes, release coordination, platform administration, issue resolution, and stakeholder engagement. This position works closely with engineering teams, product organizations, IT partners, localization teams, and support organizations to maintain the quality, availability, and reliability of software and driver delivery experiences for HP customers worldwide. Responsibilities Software & Driver Delivery Operations Review, validate, and approve software and driver publication requests. Execute and monitor software publishing and release workflows. Support operational issue resolution and escalation management. Ensure publishing activities comply with established quality and security requirements. Coordinate release readiness activities across multiple stakeholders. Operational Support and Governance Lead continuous improvement efforts by evaluating existing processes, identifying efficiency opportunities, and partnering with cross-functional teams to implement scalable solutions that enhance operational performance and efficiency. Manage ticketing systems and operational requests and work closely with stakeholders to ensure timely resolution. Investigate and coordinate resolution of issues related to publishing, translation, content and data. Monitor operational performance, publication volumes, SLA adherence, exceptions, trends, etc. Support business-critical software releases and launches. Maintain operational documentation, knowledge repositories, and support procedures. Provide recurring and ad-hoc reporting to leadership and business stakeholders. Analyze operational trends, identify risks, and drive continuous improvement opportunities. Platform Administration Administer and support operational flows of platforms used to publish software and drivers. Manage platform configurations, operating system definitions, product classifications, and publication settings. Manage user access, onboarding, and training activities. Support platform enhancements, testing activities, and process improvements. Stakeholder Management Partner with engineering, IT, support operations, and business teams. Coordinate issue resolution and communication across organizations. Provide operational status updates and escalation support. Drive follow-through on actions impacting customer-facing delivery platforms. Education & Experience Recommended Four-year or Graduate Degree in in Computer Science, Information Technology or other related discipline or equivalent work experience. 5+ years of work experience in Customer Support Operations, Self-service channels, Digital Operations, Release Operations, Product Operations, Technical Operations, or similar operational roles. Experience supporting customer-facing digital platforms, enterprise applications, workflows, web operations, software delivery, content management, or release operations. JIRA or similar work management tools. Experience managing operational workflows, tickets, incidents, escalations and issue resolution. Stakeholder management and cross-functional coordination. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced operational environment. Proficiency in data analysis and Microsoft Excel; experience with Power BI development or other BI tools is preferred but not required. Knowledge of Agile methodologies and user story management. Preferred Certifications • Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification Knowledge & Skills • Project management • Project planning • Information technology (IT) • Systems integration • Project management software • Process improvements • Infrastructure design • Security management • Risk management • Internal communications • Contract management • Project controls Cross-Org Skills • Effective Communication • Results Orientation • Learning Agility • Digital Fluency • Customer Centricity Impact & Scope • Impacts function and leads projects requiring understanding of multiple disciplines or areas of HP. Complexity • Uses managerial concepts and company objectives to resolve issues in creative and effective ways. Disclaimer • This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management. The role analyzes data, contributes to long-term strategies, fosters relationships, and collaborates across departments for continuous sales improvement and growth. Responsibilities • Provides sales support on complex engagements while maintaining the sales pipeline and achieving and/or exceeding goals and quotas. • Initiates customer contact and follows up on leads, proactively engaging with customers to sell the organization’s offerings. • Maintains an in-depth understanding of the company's products or services and effectively communicates their value propositions to both clients and junior team members. • Collaborates with senior management to contribute to the development of long-term sales strategies, including target market expansion, product positioning, and sales channel optimization. • Stays updated about industry trends, competitor activities, and emerging market opportunities, sharing insights with the team and contributing to the overall strategy. • Fosters and maintains strong relationships with key customers, understanding their evolving needs and working to ensure their satisfaction and loyalty. • Analyzes sales data, trends, and market insights to prepare accurate sales forecasts and reports for management. • Collaborates closely with other departments such as marketing, product development, and customer support to address customer needs and drive continuous improvement. • Identifies areas for process enhancement within the sales cycle to streamline operations and increase efficiency. • Explores and identifies new market opportunities, potential partnerships, and avenues for revenue growth. jobDescription:
Job Summary • This role is responsible for developing and implementing strategic plans to drive business growth while fostering strong client relationships with enterprise accounts. The role anticipates client requirements, collaborates with cross-functional teams, and uses consultative selling to identify opportunities aligned with the organization's capabilities. The role maintains a healthy sales pipeline, achieves revenue targets, and provides valuable feedback and insights to the internal teams. Responsibilities • Develops and executes account business plans including transactional and strategic initiatives to grow the organization’s business. • Builds strong professional working relationships with clients maintaining a high level of customer loyalty and developing a deep understanding of clients’ needs. • Utilizes consultative-selling techniques to identify and advance growth opportunities within existing accounts and align the organization’s capabilities to client business and IT priorities. • Anticipates client needs and facilitates solution development in collaboration with cross-functional teams and industry experts. • Leads contract negotiations, pricing discussions, and contract renewals to ensure favorable terms for both the client and the organization. • Builds and maintains sales pipeline activity while achieving and/or exceeding revenue and margin quotas using margin management techniques. • Provides feedback to internal teams based on client interactions to improve products, services, and processes. • Prepares regular reports and presentations for both internal stakeholders and the client to share regular updates on deliverables, roadblocks, etc. • Seeks opportunities to enhance the overall account management process and contribute to best practices within the account management team. Education & Experience Recommended • Four-year or Graduate Degree in Sales, Marketing, Business Administration, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence. • Typically has 4-7 years of work experience, preferably in customer relationship management, account management, or a related field or an advanced degree with 3-5 years of work experience. Preferred Certifications NA Knowledge & Skills • Account Management • Business Development • Business Planning • Business To Business • Cross-Selling • Customer Relationship Management • Finance • Market Share • Marketing • Merchandising • Product Knowledge • Sales Management • Sales Process • Sales Prospecting • Sales Strategy • Sales Territory Management • Salesforce • Selling Techniques • Upselling • Value Propositions Cross-Org Skills • Effective Communication • Results Orientation • Learning Agility • Digital Fluency • Customer Centricity Impact & Scope • Impacts multiple teams and may act as a team or project leader providing direction to team activities and facilitates information validation and team decision making process. Complexity • Responds to moderately complex issues within established guidelines. Disclaimer • This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management. title: India Development Centre - IDC
jobDescription:
Job Summary Please note, this is a general listing and may not have an immediate opening. We will contact candidates who best meet the job requirements as such openings arise. About the Role At HP, we’re building the future of personal computing — bold, inclusive, and driven by innovation. As an integral part of India Development Center, you’ll be at the forefront of creating products and solutions that cater to diverse consumer needs across the globe. This is more than a role — it’s an invitation to lead transformative work that reaches millions globally. Whether you're passionate about crafting intuitive user experiences, architecting reliable system software, or defining the form factor of a category-defining device, this is your chance to work at the edge of innovation. We’re assembling a cross-functional team of product managers, designers, engineers, and researchers united by curiosity, craftsmanship, and a shared mission: to design technology that enhances how people live, learn, and create.
